web_admin_not_admin_body: This number isn't, or is no longer, on the administrator list. Log out, or ask the ShikkhokPlus team if you think it should be.
web_admin_privacy_note: Students and guardians appear only as counts, or as a role and a reference number. No phone numbers are shown.
web_admin_role_centre_members_sub: Managers and teachers at a centre
web_admin_not_reported_help: Last seen on an app version that predates reporting which app it is.
web_admin_no_versions: No app has reported a version in the last 30 days.
web_admin_status_answered_sub: Waiting on the person who asked
web_admin_no_requesters: Nobody has asked a question yet.
web_admin_auth_tagline: Support and platform figures, for the ShikkhokPlus team.
web_admin_auth_point_allowlist: Only numbers on the administrator list can log in.
web_admin_auth_point_two_codes: Every log-in needs an SMS code and a code from your authenticator app.
web_admin_auth_point_hour: A session lasts an hour, and ends when you close the tab.
web_admin_signin_sub: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS to an administrator's number.
web_admin_signin_code_sent: If this number is an administrator's, we sent it a 6-digit code by SMS.
web_admin_signin_not_admin: This number can't log in to ShikkhokPlus admin.
web_admin_unavailable: ShikkhokPlus admin isn't available from this connection. Open it at the admin address, from an allowed network.
web_admin_enroll_body: Scan this code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. You'll need a code from it every time you log in.
web_admin_enroll_qr_label: QR code to add ShikkhokPlus admin to your authenticator app
web_admin_enroll_key_label: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app instead:
web_admin_enroll_code_label: Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows
web_admin_challenge_time: Finish within 5 minutes, or log-in starts again.
web_admin_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
web_admin_verify_body: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for ShikkhokPlus admin.
web_admin_recovery_help: One of the 10 codes you saved at setup. Each one works once.
web_admin_wrong_code: That code isn't right. Enter the code the app shows now.
web_admin_wrong_recovery: That recovery code isn't right, or it has already been used.
web_admin_locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
web_admin_challenge_expired: That took longer than 5 minutes, so log-in has started again. Ask for a new SMS code.
web_admin_session_ended: Your admin session has ended. Log in again to carry on.
web_admin_codes_warning: Save these now. Each code works once, and they're the only way in if you lose your phone. They won't be shown again.
web_admin_codes_where: Keep them somewhere safe that isn't your phone, such as a password manager or a printed sheet.
